body: A label is not a category. Before a word goes on an exclusion list, say which body of work it names and who else uses it that way. (2026-09-23. Metaphysics sat on the contaminated list for eight years because a 2018 notebook page used it as a heading for New Thought material. The word is off the list; New Thought, Hermeticism, the Kybalion and Law of Attraction remain. Metaphysics as a discipline has never been searched, and per constraint 23 that is recorded as unsettled, not as out of scope.)
plain: A label is not a category.
